limitations: --offline suppresses startup network activity; it is not an OS network sandbox.
--no-tools is the first-slice tool policy, not a filesystem sandbox. The built-in read tool supports absolute paths and cannot justify a workspace-read claim.
--no-session only avoids persisted conversation history. Native CLI settings/cache/auth refresh effects remain platform-owned and must be qualified separately.
Do not change PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, copy credentials, read auth/config files, or issue set_auto_retry/set_auto_compaction as a harmless handshake. Their setters save native settings.

The SDK supports SettingsManager.inMemory/SessionManager.inMemory and a supplied resource loader; adding an SDK launcher is a separate choice only if native CLI lifecycle cannot meet the registered policy. Do not introduce it speculatively.

minimal_driver_state_machine: Subscribe/read before issuing any prompt; validate UTF-8 JSONL with LF framing and CRLF support, bounded records/total output. U+2028/U+2029 are not record delimiters.
Send Host-issued get_state ID, correlate response ID and command, pin one nonempty native sessionId. Do not project model/config/auth objects.

Send exactly one prompt with a fresh Host command ID. started permits observing work; queued is queue acceptance, handled can have no native run. Neither is task completion, and neither is permission to resend.
Observe agent_start and authoritative message_end; allowlist assistant text and supported tool observations. Drop thinking events and model/config objects from persisted/public events.

agent_end alone is not terminal. Require agent_settled, a subsequent correlated get_state with isStreaming=false/isCompacting=false/pendingMessageCount=0, coherent native session identity and actual assistant stop reason.
For handled without agent_start, finish the Host attempt with the actual disposition and a supported no-native-work outcome; never invent native run identity or wait indefinitely for agent_settled.

For cancel: stop outer dispatch, send clear_queue and validate its response, then abort and validate its response, then verify idle/empty state. Never echo returned queued prompt text into public logs.

Close/stop the owned long-lived RPC process after native idle/settled; retain actual exit/Host-close reason and require Job empty, process identity and stream-drain proof. agent_settled is not OS cleanup and a Host kill must not be reported as exit 0.

Lost ACK, malformed/truncated frame, inconsistent identity, unproven stop or disconnect becomes UNKNOWN/reconciliation through existing durable Run facts. No auto prompt resend/new session/Harness fallback.
